declarations.name: AuiBoxPlot

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Chart title: visible text and the accessible name of the plot (aria-labelledby). Must not be blank.

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the title; it stays the accessible name.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Visible description below the title, also referenced by aria-describedby (text only).

inputs.name: summary
inputs.description: Replaces the generated accessible summary (series and category counts, per-series lowest and highest median, hidden series).

inputs.name: valueFormat
inputs.description: Number format for statistics in box names, the tooltip, the data table, the summary, and axis ticks (ticks use fixed fraction digits).

inputs.name: formatValue
inputs.description: Custom value text; overrides valueFormat everywhere except axis ticks.

inputs.name: categories
inputs.description: Category labels, one per box group (text only).

inputs.name: series
inputs.description: Series: { id, label, data: BoxPlotDatum[], color?: 1-8 }, one datum per category. A datum is precomputed statistics { min, q1, median, q3, max, outliers? } (finite, min <= q1 <= median <= q3 <= max; min and max are the whisker ends), raw values number[] (non-finite values ignored), or null (no box).

inputs.name: categoryAxis
inputs.description: Category axis title; also the first data table column header (default "Category").

inputs.name: valueAxis
inputs.description: Value axis title, fixed domain (max > min; marks are clamped to it), and approximate tick count (2-20). includeZero is validated but has no effect on a box plot; the automatic domain spans every whisker and outlier.

inputs.name: annotations
inputs.description: Reference lines ({ type: 'line', axis: 'x' | 'y', value, label?, tone? }) and bands ({ type: 'band', axis, from, to, label?, tone? }); tone: 'neutral' | 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger'. x values are category labels or indexes; y values are numbers. Drawn under the marks (aria-hidden); listed in the accessible summary.

inputs.name: theme
inputs.description: Look and feel: { palette?: string[] (1-8 CSS colors for slots 1-8); fontFamily?; fontSize? (8-32 px); textColor?; gridLines?: boolean; gridColor?; gridDash? ("4 2" or "none"); axisColor?; lineWidth? (0.5-12 px); markerSize? (1-20 px); cornerRadius?, barRadius?, cellRadius?, sliceRadius?, boxRadius? (0-50 px); swatchRadius? (0-8 px); tooltipRadius?, controlRadius? (0-50 px); lineJoin?: 'round' | 'miter' | 'bevel'; areaOpacity? (0-1); gradient?: boolean; valueLabelColor?; tooltip?: { background?, color?, borderColor? }; legendPosition?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'start' | 'end'; animation?: boolean | { duration?: number (0-5000 ms) } }. Applied as --aui-chart-* custom properties and classes on the host through the CSSOM (CSP-safe); colors are validated with CSS.supports('color'). Animation is opt-in and never runs with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or [data-aui-animation='none'].

inputs.name: renderTooltip
inputs.description: Custom tooltip content as DOM nodes (never HTML strings). context: { title, rows: { label, value, seriesId }[], column, row, source: "pointer" | "focus" | "sync" }. Return null for the default tooltip. The tooltip stays aria-hidden; the focused mark keeps its accessible label.

inputs.name: syncGroup
inputs.description: Synchronized crosshair: charts with the same group show the crosshair, highlight, and tooltip at the same column (category or x index) when one of them is hovered or focused. Focus never moves between charts. Use charts that share their categories or x values.

inputs.name: legend
inputs.description: auto: legend (toggle buttons) when there is more than one series.

inputs.name: dataTable
inputs.description: Data table fallback (one row per category and series: Minimum, Lower quartile, Median, Upper quartile, Maximum, Outliers): behind a Show data table button (built on first open), always visible, visually hidden (screen readers only), or none.

inputs.name: tooltip
inputs.description: Tooltip on pointer hover and keyboard focus (maximum, quartiles, median, minimum, outlier count).

inputs.name: patterns
inputs.description: Texture fills on the boxes (and legend keys) of the second and later series so series never differ by color alone (always on in forced colors).

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Plot height in CSS px (integer 120-2000); the width follows the container.

inputs.name: whiskers
inputs.description: Whiskers computed from raw values: tukey (whiskers end at the most extreme values within 1.5 IQR of the quartiles; values beyond are outliers) or minmax (whiskers at the minimum and maximum, no outliers). Precomputed statistics are drawn as given.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Number, list, and message locale.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: rtl mirrors the category axis and series order, moves the value axis to the right, and swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.

models.name: hiddenSeries
models.description: Ids of series hidden initially; update() replaces the hidden set.

outputs.name: seriesToggled
outputs.description: The user toggled a legend entry (pointer or keyboard). Not emitted for update() or setSeriesVisible().

outputs.name: pointClicked
outputs.description: A data mark was activated: pointer click or tap, or Enter / Space on the focused mark. label is the category, x value, or item; value is the formatted value text. Keyboard navigation is unchanged.

methods.name: setSeriesVisible
methods.description: Show or hide a series programmatically; emits no event.

accessibility.pattern: SVG box plot as a named, described group (role="group" with aria-roledescription "box plot") of role="img" boxes with roving focus; data table fallback (native table with every statistic and the outlier values).

limitations: Every series needs exactly one datum per category.
whiskers applies to raw values only; precomputed statistics are drawn as given.
Outliers are decorative dots; their values are listed in the data table and counted in the box name.
A fixed valueAxis domain clamps boxes, whiskers, and outliers to its edges; valueAxis.includeZero is accepted but has no effect.
